changelog:
• Automatic Update on Launch: App automatically detects updates and presents the update dialog upon launch when Auto-Update is enabled in Settings
• Fixed Connection Interrupted Error: Removed process Wi-Fi binding so updates download seamlessly over Cellular/Internet even while connected to robot camera
• Resilient Downloader: Enhanced HTTP redirect resolution, timeout resiliency, and instant APK installation trigger upon download completion
• Settings Auto-Update Sync: Default enabled with persistent switch state in Settings
